description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) called LeaveStatusWithLengthDays, which encapsulates information about a leave status, including its ID, name, and the length of days associated with that status. The class provides getters and setters for its properties, as well as a method to add days to the length.

classes.name: LeaveStatusWithLengthDays
classes.description: A DTO class representing a leave status with associated length in days, including methods to access and modify its properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the leave status with an ID, name, and optional length in days.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave status.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave status.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the leave status.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the leave status.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the length in days associated with the leave status.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the length in days associated with the leave status.

methods.name: addToLengthDays
methods.description: Adds a specified number of days to the existing lengthDays property.
